sn12.33:1.3: Taṃ suṇātha sādhukam manasi karotha bhāsissāmīti || ||
sn12.33:1.4: Evam bhante ti kho te bhikkhū Bhagavato paccassosum || || 3
sn12.33:2.2: Jarāmaraṇe ñāṇaṃ jarāmaraṇasamudaye ñāṇaṃ jarāmaraṇanirodhe ñāṇaṃ jarāmaraṇanirodhagāminiyā paṭipadāya ñāṇaṃ || || 5
sn12.33:2.3: Jātiyā ñāṇaṃ jātisamudaye ñāṇaṃ jātinirodhe ñāṇaṃ jātinirodhagāminiyā paṭipadāya ñāṇaṃ || || 6
sn12.33:2.4: Bhave ñāṇaṃ bhavasamudaye ñāṇaṃ bhavanirodhe ñāṇaṃ bhavanirodhagāminiyā paṭipadāya ñāṇaṃ || || 7
sn12.33:2.5: Upādāne ñāṇaṃ upādānasamudaye ñāṇaṃ upādānanirodhe ñāṇaṃ upādānanirodhagāminiyā paṭipadāya ñāṇaṃ || || 8
sn12.33:2.6: Taṇhāya ñāṇaṃ vedanāsamudaye ñāṇaṃ vedanānirodhe ñāṇaṃ vedanānirodhagāminiyā paṭipadāya ñāṇaṃ || || 9
sn12.33:2.7: Vedanāya ñāṇaṃ vedanāsamudaye ñāṇaṃ vedanānirodhe ñāṇaṃ vedanānirodhagāminiyā paṭipadāya ñāṇaṃ || || 10
sn12.33:2.12: Saṅkhāresu ñāṇaṃ saṅkhārasamudaye ñāṇaṃ saṅkhāranirodhe ñāṇaṃ saṅkhāranirodhagāminiyā paṭipadāya ñāṇaṃ || ||
sn12.33:3.2: Yā tesaṃ tesaṃ sattānaṃ tamhi tamhi sattanikāye jarā jīranatā khaṇḍiccaṃ pāliccam valittacatā āyuno saṃhāni indriyānaṃ paripāko ||
sn12.33:3.4: Yā tesaṃ tesaṃ sattānaṃ tamhā tamhā sattanikāyā cuti cavanatā bhedo antaradhānaṃ maccumaraṇaṃ kālakiriyā khandhānam bhedo kaḷevarassa nikkhepo ||
sn12.33:4.3: ayam eva ariyo aṭṭhaṅgiko maggo jarāmaraṇanirodhagāminī paṭipadā || seyyathīdam ||
sn12.33:5.1: Yato kho bhikkhave ariyasāvako evaṃ jarāmaraṇam pajānāti || evaṃ jarāmaraṇasamudayam pajānāti || evaṃ jarāmaraṇanirodham pajānāti || evaṃ jarāmaraṇanirodhagāminim paṭipadam pajānāti || || 18 Idhamassa dhamme ñāṇaṃ ||
sn12.33:5.2: so iminā dhammena diṭṭhena viditena akālikena pattena pariyogāḷhena atītānāgate nayaṃ neti || 19
sn12.33:6.1: Ye kho keci atītam addhānam samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā jarāmaraṇam abbhaññaṃsu || jarāmaraṇasamudayam abbhaññaṃsu || jarāmaraṇanirodham abbhaññaṃsu || jarāmaraṇanirodhagāminim paṭipadam abbhaññaṃsu || sabbe te evam evam abbhaññaṃsu || Seyyathāpaham etarahi || || 20
sn12.33:7.1: Ye hi pi keci anāgatam addhānam samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā jarāmaraṇam abhijānissanti || jarāmaraṇasamudayam abhijānissanti || jarāmaraṇanirodham abhijānissanti || jarāmaraṇanirodhagāminim paṭipadam abhijānissanti || sabbe te evam evam abhijānissanti || seyyathāpaham etarahīti ||
sn12.33:8.1: Yato kho bhikkhave ariyasāvakassa imāni dve ñāṇāni parisuddhāni honti pariyodātāni
sn12.33:8.2: dhamme ñāṇaṃ ca anvaye ñāṇaṃ ca ||
sn12.33:8.3: ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhave ariyasāvako diṭṭhisampanno iti pi || dassanasampanno iti pi || āgato imaṃ saddhammam iti pi || passati imaṃ saddhammam iti pi || sekhena ñāṇena samannāgato iti pi || sekhāya vijjāya samannāgato iti pi || dhammasotaṃ samāpanno iti pi || ariyo nibbedhikapāñño iti pi || amatadvāram āhacca tiṭṭhati iti pīti || pe|| 22
sn12.33:9.1: Katamā ca bhikkhave jāti || yā tesam || || 23
sn12.33:10.3: ayam eva ariyo aṭṭhaṅgiko maggo saṅkhāranirodhagāminī paṭipadā || seyyathīdaṃ ||
sn12.33:11.1: Yato kho bhikkhave ariyasāvako evaṃ saṅkhāre pajānāti || evaṃ saṅkhārasamudayam pajānāti || evaṃ saṅkhāranirodham pajānāti || evaṃ saṅkharā nirodhagaminiṃ paṭipadam pajānāti || idam assa dhamme ñāṇaṃ || ||
sn12.33:11.2: So iminā dhammena diṭṭhena viditena akālikena pattena pariyogāḷhena atītānāgate nayaṃ neti || || 34
sn12.33:12.1: Ye kho keci atītam addhānam samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā saṅkhare abbhaññaṃsu saṅkharasamudayam abbhaññaṃsu || saṅkhāranirodham abbhaññaṃsu || sabbe te evam evam abbhaññaṃsu seyyathāpaham etarahi || 35
sn12.33:13.1: Ye pi hi keci anāgatam addhānaṃ samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā saṅkhāre abhijānissanti || saṅkhārasamudayam abhijānissanti || saṅkhāranirodham abhijānissanti || saṅkhāranirodhagāminim paṭipadam abhijānissanti || sabbe te evam evam abhijānissanti || seyyathāpaham etarahi ||
sn12.33:14.1: Yato kho bhikkhave ariyasāvakassa imāni dve ñāṇāni parisuddhāni honti pariyodātāni
sn12.33:14.2: dhamme ñāṇaṃ ca anvaye ñāṇaṃ ca ||
sn12.33:14.3: ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhave āriyasāvako diṭṭhisampanno iti pi || dassanasampanno iti pi || āgato imaṃ saddhammam iti pi || passati imaṃ saddhammam iti pi || sekhena ñāṇena samannāgato iti pi || sekhayā vijjāya samannāgato iti pi || dhammasotam samāpanno iti pi || ariyo nibbedhikapañño iti pi || amatadvāram āhacca tiṭṭhati iti pīti || ||
